name: G6 T3 W03 Part 1 - Build a table and chart
description: Build a table and chart. 2 words. Required: Flashcards and Matching. Read the Spark with the same name. Use this part in its Technology class.

words.definition: Facts and values that a computer can store and use.
words.example: The data shows that 12 students chose chess.

words.definition: A picture that shows data so it is easier to compare.
words.example: The chart uses bars to compare the club counts.
